labeling: Author-labeled synthetic examples, fixed before model evaluation. These are regression cases, not a representative or independently adjudicated production sample.

cases.body: OK, thanks.
cases.reason: A bare acknowledgement contains no action, outcome, or remaining work.

cases.body: Хорошо, спасибо.
cases.reason: A bare acknowledgement contains no durable intent.

cases.body: Done.
cases.reason: Completion without an identified action or result supplies no evidence.

cases.body: I am reading the files now.
cases.reason: Transient activity is not a finding.

cases.body: Directory listing: README.md, src/, tests/.
cases.reason: The listing gives no nonobvious structure or finding.

cases.body: Directory listing: README.md, src/, tests/.
cases.reason: Repeating the same routine output adds no future value.

cases.body: Read src/helper.py lines 1-20. The output contains imports and an empty helper function.
cases.reason: A routine code read with no conclusion is disposable.

cases.body: Launched the unit tests; no results yet.
cases.reason: Starting a check does not establish its outcome.

cases.body: Periodic snapshot: PID 4100 present; queue length 0; indexed count 8. No change since the previous snapshot.
cases.reason: Repeated healthy counters alone have no durable project value.

cases.body: Re-read README.md. The text is unchanged from the preceding read.
cases.reason: An unchanged repeated read is activity, not new evidence.

cases.body: Понял.
cases.reason: An acknowledgement alone contains no durable preference or constraint.

cases.body: Command: pwd. Output: /tmp/fixture-project.
cases.reason: A temporary working-directory print has no durable finding.

cases.body: We chose one SQLite transaction for note and source-link writes because a crash between separate commits can leave a note without provenance.
cases.reason: Records an explicit design decision and why it exists.

cases.body: Решили не включать весь диск: захватываем только явно выбранные проекты, чтобы не смешивать личные записи и рабочие решения.
cases.reason: Records an explicit scope decision with rationale.

cases.body: A generated note must cite only retained source IDs. Raw rejected history must never be passed to the memory generator.
cases.reason: A nonobvious provenance constraint guides future changes.

cases.body: test_rejected_source_cannot_be_cited passed: the processor rejected a note referencing source s2 after the eligibility gate discarded s2.
cases.reason: A named completed regression check establishes a precise tested behavior.

cases.body: test_rejected_history_is_absent failed: the generator request still contained the body of rejected context c4.
cases.reason: A completed failing check exposes a broken invariant.

cases.body: The new query ranked the current decision first in three local fixtures. Retrieval from a fresh native session remains untested.
cases.reason: The observed result and evidence limit must both survive.

cases.body: The worker exited with runner_failure after the child returned a valid payload wrapped in a result field. The queue stayed blocked across restart.
cases.reason: A concrete failure and trigger are useful diagnostic evidence.

cases.body: Нашли контрпример: после истечения lease старый воркер дописал заметку, хотя новый уже забрал batch. Двойная запись воспроизводится в тесте.
cases.reason: A reproducible concurrency failure is durable evidence.

cases.body: Before releasing the recovery fix, verify that a failed project does not starve another project with pending observations.
cases.reason: An explicit release obligation remains open.

cases.body: Осталось выяснить, почему русский запрос о последних решениях возвращает старые промежуточные заметки.
cases.reason: Names an unresolved question without inventing its answer.

cases.body: When reporting maintenance, always separate captured observations, successful processing, and actual recall. A full index alone is not proof of useful memory.
cases.reason: A durable user reporting preference applies beyond this turn.

cases.body: Не называй исправление установленным, пока не проверил фактический runtime и повторный запуск обработчика.
cases.reason: An explicit durable correction changes future completion criteria.

cases.body: The retry counter is stored per project in service-state.json, whereas failed batch attempts are stored in SQLite. Restarting the service preserves the project counter.
cases.reason: The state relationship explains why a restart may not unblock work.

cases.body: The user's decision concerns collection scope. It does not authorize publishing captured text or rewriting existing curated notes.
cases.reason: Preserves a necessary distinction in interpreting prior intent.

cases.body: I believe the timeout is caused by a stale child process, but I have not inspected the process tree. Treat this as a hypothesis to check.
cases.reason: Useful unresolved hypothesis is retained without promoting it into fact.

cases.body: Replace the earlier unlimited-retry decision with at most three delayed automatic retries. Keep permanent schema failures blocked for explicit repair.
cases.reason: An explicit superseding decision must be available to future work.

cases.body: The second worker still writes after the lease expires; stack trace is truncated here.
cases.reason: Incomplete evidence with a concrete failure must not be discarded.

cases.body: Only after the lease expires, otherwise the existing worker still owns it.
cases.reason: Context is incomplete but may supply an important ownership constraint.
